conventions.confidence: Carried unchanged from the brand files. 'verified' there means read from the manufacturer's own page, label or manual through a search-engine extract (direct fetch was blocked); an independent fact-check pass had no web access. conventions.pairKits: Where only a pair-kit price exists, it is split 25% indoor / 75% outdoor (see pairKitCosts and item notes). Always cost a single split as the sum of its pair.
conventions.compatibility: All rules are 'provisional'. connectableIndoorModels are partly derived by the researchers (capacity or port-size inference, or retailer bundles), not official combination tables. Gate multi-split combinations behind tech-lead confirmation.
